Kids These Days Could Really Use Your Help

Kids these days are facing a lot. The world has changed, and so have their health issues. That’s why, with your help, we’re reimagining health care and creating more accessible and innovative solutions. Together, we can make a lasting impact on the lives of our young patients and their families.

    CHEO Charity Classic presented by RBC

    CHEO Foundation and The Royal Ottawa Golf Club are proud to host the CHEO Charity Classic presented by RBC on Monday, July 6, 2026. This is the second of three annual tournaments in support of CHEO’s transformation of pediatric care through the Kids These Days redevelopment.
